主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. appealed the NASDAQ's decision to delist its shares from the NASDAQ Global Select Market. On May 20, 2014, NASDAQ informed the company that its appeal was granted, contingent on the company informing the panel by August 31, 2014, that it had solicited proxies and held an annual shareholder meeting. The company plans to hold its annual general meeting on July 30, 2014, with a record date of June 24, 2014. It expects to mail proxy materials to shareholders by June 30, 2014.
